contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS [REPVBLICAE] ; D/ [...] VALENTINIAN VS PF AVG

Copper alloy Nummus of Valentinian I. Mint is Arles, AD367-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS [REPVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left with wreath. See LRBC no.527 p.56. Obverse shows Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] VALENTINIAN VS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: -/-//PCON. Condition is worn, die axis is 6 o'clock.…
